facts.fact: Africa Data Protection reports that the HAPDP was abolished by decree on 8 June 2026 and the provisions of the December 2022 data protection law that founded it were repealed by ordonnance, with its tasks passing to two ministries.

Africa Data Protection reports that on 8 June 2026 an ordonnance repealed provisions of Niger's December 2022 data protection law that founded the supervisory authority, which a decree abolished the same day.
